label: MODEL_ONLY FORECAST_ONLY NOT_MEASURED_IN_THIS_SYSTEM
what_this_is: The set of identities this package is willing to treat as hardware reviewers. A review record naming an identity that does not resolve here is refused, and a record it would have admitted stays out of every gate-evidence dossier.
what_this_is_NOT: This is a DECLARATION, NOT AN AUTHENTICATION. Nothing in this package can establish that an entry below corresponds to a person, that a review attributed to one was written by them, or that the writer had read the record. Whoever can write this file holds hardware-review authority; the roster makes that fact addressable and auditable, it does not remove it.
why_it_is_empty: No hardware data exists, no hardware review has been performed, and no reviewer has been registered out of band. An empty roster is therefore the true state and not a placeholder: today no review record can be valid and no gate-evidence dossier can have entries. PASS remains zero; automatic_gate_effect remains NONE.
registration_rule: A reviewer entry is usable only if its registered_by is the declared out-of-band bootstrap constant, or another roster entry of kind HUMAN that is itself usable. Self-registration is refused, and so is a registration cycle. This mirrors qta_agent/agents.py, where an agent instance may not mint a HUMAN principal.

entry_schema.reviewer_id: exact string named by review_record.reviewer_id; matching is case-sensitive and exact
entry_schema.kind: HUMAN | TOOL | SERVICE -- only HUMAN may author a review
entry_schema.registered_by: OUT_OF_BAND_BOOTSTRAP, or the reviewer_id of a usable HUMAN entry
entry_schema.retired_on: ISO-8601 or null; a retired reviewer may not author a review
